A user with no affiliation to the company says they've used Loops and like it because it's easy. They suspect alternatives would be more complex and more annoying to use, even if those might be cheaper.
"I'm a happy user!" They'd still like some small basic things, such as better filtering and user editing, but "overall they get the job done."
A user reported that clicking "Pricing" on the Loops site gave no response; they had to be given the direct loops.so/pricing link.

One user said their Firefox browser (with adblock) consumed 600% CPU while browsing the Loops homepage, suggesting an endless loop. Another said they see the same with Framer-built sites in Chrome too.
A commenter criticized Loops' pricing model: charging per contact and allowing unlimited emails to an address "seems priced in a way that encourages spam."

A visitor found the Product Hunt upvote badge front and centre on the Loops homepage distracting, "verging on devaluing to the product offering." They suggested moving it down so the service is the focus.

A commenter comparing Loops to Customer.io and Userlist said email tools are crowded. Since most send via Amazon SES or Sendgrid under the hood, they called deliverability differentiation claims by any such platform "dubious at best."
